findings.source_en: Upon death inside a <Bold>Dungeon</>, gives the option to revive at its entrance
findings.ar: إذا هلكتَ داخل <Bold>سرداب</>، أتاح لك النهوض عند مدخله
findings.issue: 'revive' is rendered النهوض (standing back up). This is the death/respawn mechanic — the player is brought back to life at the Dungeon entrance — and النهوض does not say that. Dungeon=سرداب is correct.
findings.suggested_ar: إذا هلكتَ داخل <Bold>سرداب</>، أتاح لك أن تُبعَث عند مدخله

findings.issue: يُنزل is the frozen verb for inflicting a STATUS, kept deliberately distinct from the damage verb. A guaranteed Critical Hit is on the damage side, so this reuses the status verb and blurs the split the glossary set up.
